text:
PulseForge is a fast-growing HR tech startup building tools that help mid-sized companies scale people operations with empathy and data. We’re a tight-knit team moving fast to launch new hiring and employee lifecycle products — and we need an experienced HR pro to own end-to-end talent acquisition and help shape our people practices.

What you'll do
- Lead full-cycle Recruitment for engineering, product, and go-to-market roles: sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer management and closing.
- Use LinkedIn Recruiter to build talent pipelines, run targeted outreach campaigns, and hire passive candidates.
- Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, create compelling job briefs, and run efficient interview processes.
- Manage candidate experience, coordinate interview logistics, and maintain ATS data hygiene.
- Analyze hiring metrics and cycle-times; recommend process improvements to reduce time-to-fill and improve quality of hire.
- Support employer branding initiatives and campus/industry outreach as needed.
- Collaborate with People Ops to ensure smooth handoffs post-offer.

What we need (mandatory)
- Recruitment
- LinkedIn Recruiter
- 6-10 years

What we need (additional context)
- Strong stakeholder management and excellent communication skills.
- Proven track record hiring across technical and non-technical roles in a fast-paced environment.
- Comfortable working independently and running multiple searches simultaneously.
- High attention to detail and focus on candidate experience.

Bonus points (preferred / good-to-have)
- Onboarding
- Workday

Location and work mode
Bengaluru, on-site 5 days a week. No remote option.
